courses.title: Six Healing Sounds Guided Qigong Meditation Instruction Video Download
courses.description: A video lesson in the Taoist Six Healing Sounds, adding postures and a sound for each organ to the Inner Smile practice. It is the second of three linked meditations, between the Inner Smile and the Microcosmic Orbit.

courses.title: Tao of Beauty Guided QiGong Meditation MP3
courses.description: A short daily guided qigong visualisation on holding an image of self-love and inner beauty. She pairs it with her three core practices (Microcosmic Orbit, Inner Smile and the healing sounds) and suggests sixty days of practice.

courses.title: Basic Medical Qigong Online Certification Course
courses.description: A mostly self-study certification for practitioners and teachers who want to share three foundational Taoist meditations: the Microcosmic Orbit, the Inner Smile and the Six Healing Sounds. It includes four hours of one-to-one video consultation with a certified instructor and a certificate on completion.

left_out: 5 Element Organs Elixir QiGong video courses: the lung course says the exercises turn 'many physical ailments' into health and links unreleased stress to asthma and lung disease; treatment claims.
Tao of Cleansing MP3: says it flushes toxins from the organs and ties toxic thoughts to lowered immune response; immunity claim.
World Link remote healing MP3: sold as a 'MUST' for people with an ill loved one and for healthcare providers; read as remote treatment of illness (borderline).
Women's Tao Sexual Health practices and sexual energy packages: sold on balancing hormones and use a jade egg; hormonal-health claim.
Taoist Healing Massage and Pain Relief pages, Chi Nei Tsang course: not re-checked (Chi Nei Tsang was sold with a 'Constipation Cure' video).
Six Healing Sounds MP3 and the combined Inner Smile & Six Healing Sounds MP3: duplicates of the video lesson.
flags: Basic Medical Qigong: 'Medical' is in the title and it is aimed at natural health practitioners, but the page claims only to improve health and lower stress. A human may prefer it out given the earlier note that her brand leans medical.
Basic Medical Qigong price: the page lists '$450' as the course deposit due on enrolment.
